limits: Browser backend, auth, RTC, writer, synthesis and ASR are synthetic; native Chromium AudioWorklet/WASM is exercised. No model generation or production writes. Stale call/scope/ending clear guards also independently reviewed in source.
runtime_assertions: 503 recovery retains owned failure warning and disabled microphone
redundant connected event cannot clear unresolved authority failure
fresh validated authority clears its exact original notice immediately
held recovery ACK cannot clear a newer ASR warning
redundant connected event preserves newer unrelated warning
connected preserves newer warning replacing its owned transport notice
connected clears its own transport notice only
independent_source_review: Stale call, scope and ending guards run before any owned-notice clear.
